2. ऐसे ऐप से दूर रहें और किसी भी तरह का निवेश न करें। SEBI ने साफ किया है कि गारंटीड रिटर्न का वादा करना प्रतिभूति बाजार में एक घोटाला है। ['sebi-f7196f25#0002', 'sebi-f7196f25#0003']
3. यदि आपने पहले ही कोई ऐप डाउनलोड कर लिया है या पैसा ट्रांसफर कर दिया है, तो तुरंत साइबर क्राइम हेल्पलाइन 1930 पर शिकायत दर्ज कराएं या cybercrime.gov.in पर जाएं। ['sebi-f7196f25#0002', 'sebi-f7196f25#0003', 'pressinf-0aa4344f#0009']

question: I got a call from someone claiming to be from the RBI or a government agency, saying my bank account will be blocked unless I share my OTP and install a given app. Is this real?
final_steps_with_citations:
1. Immediately end the call. Do not share your OTP, do not download any app, and do not provide any bank details. Official advisories state that RBI does not send such calls, nor does it ask individuals to deposit money or share OTPs for account protection. ['rbi-bb1830ff#0003']
2. If you have already shared any details or installed the app, disconnect the call right away and do not follow any further instructions from the caller. ['rbi-bb1830ff#0003']
3. Report the incident through the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal at cybercrime.gov.in or call the dedicated helpline 1930 for immediate assistance. ['pressinf-0aa4344f#0009', 'departme-09c0c586#0000']
4. Contact your bank’s official customer-care number (found on the back of your card or the bank’s website) to inform them of the attempted fraud and to secure your account. ['rbi-843271d7#0003']
5. Do not trust Caller-ID displays; cybercriminals can spoof names such as "RBI" or "Government agency". RBI has warned that such calls claiming account-blockage are fraudulent. ['rbi-bb1830ff#0003']
6. Never share your UPI PIN, OTP, or install any screen‑sharing or remote‑access app at the request of an unknown caller, even if they claim to be from a regulatory authority. ['rbi-843271d7#0003']
7. Save any call‑record, message, or app‑installation evidence and provide it when filing the cyber‑crime complaint; this aids investigation and potential recovery. ['rbi-843271d7#0003']
